edges.subject: aging
edges.quote: Lysosomal dysfunction is a well-recognized feature of aging.

edges.subject: glycerophosphodiesters
edges.quote: Aged lysosomes in brain, heart, muscle, and white adipose tissue accumulated glycerophosphodiesters and cystine, metabolites that are causally linked to juvenile lysosomal storage disorders, Batten disease, and cystinosis.

edges.subject: caloric restriction
edges.quote: Caloric restriction, a lifespan-extending intervention, mitigated these changes in the heart and muscle but not the brain.
